state.goal: Search Google Flights for a one-way flight from SFO to JFK next Friday.

op.instructions: Given `goal` and the current `observed_elements` on `url`, what is the single next UI operation to perform?

criteria.click: Click an element (e.g. a button, radio, or link)
criteria.type: Type text into a focused textbox/combobox
criteria.wait: Wait for the page to load or update
criteria.done: The goal is already satisfied; no further action needed

target_index.instructions: Which `observed_elements` index (by its `index` field, as a string) should the operation act on? Use `none` if the operation needs no target (e.g. wait/done).

is_destructive.instructions: Would performing this operation have an external side effect (payment, sending, deleting, submitting an order)?
